messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing. They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis population mean 98.6. They ask: "計算...的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6." Possibly they want to compute the standard error or the standard deviation of the sampling distribution? Or maybe they want to compute the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error of the mean under the null hypothesis. That is sqrt(population variance / n). But we don't know population variance. They gave sample standard deviation 1.4. Usually we use sample standard deviation as estimate of population standard deviation. So standard error = sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40) ≈ 6.3249. 1.4 / 6.3249 ≈ 0.2214. So standard error ~0.221. But the phrase "以得到人口平均值為98.6" might mean they want to compute the p-value for testing H0: mu=98.6 vs alternative? They didn't specify alternative. But maybe they want to compute the p-value. The tool provided is "statistics_calculate_p_value" which calculates p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. It requires sample_mean, population_mean, sample_std_dev, sample_size, two_tailed optional. So we can call that function. The user didn't specify two-tailed or one-tailed. Default is two-tailed. So we can compute p-value. Let's do that. We'll call the function with sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. Then we get p-value. That might be what they want. The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might be mis-translation. But the tool is available. So let's call it.
